name: OS-Tutor-RAG retrieval benchmark

relevance_scale.2: directly relevant: the chunk itself answers or substantially explains what the query asks
relevance_scale.1: somewhat relevant / background: partial, supporting or example material a student would still find useful
relevance_scale.0: not relevant (not listed; every chunk not listed for a query is treated as non-relevant)

annotation: Queries and judgments were written by the Phase 3A annotator (Claude, single annotator) after reading all 463 chunk texts; the dense retriever was never consulted. A keyword audit (regex search over chunk text, independent of the embedding model) then listed unjudged chunks containing each query's key terms; each listed chunk was read and added only if its text supports the query. Judgments are incomplete by construction (unlisted = non-relevant); incompleteness is reported at evaluation time as unjudged results in the top-k. Frozen before the first evaluation run; not edited after seeing retrieval results.
